*REQUEST FOR HELP: Update UI Screenshots in Mifos X User Manual* 

For any of our aspiring interns or any of volunteers or individuals looking to contribute we have a set of small but meaningful tasks that would be super helpful to the community and a good way of starting to familiarize yourself with the capabilities of Mifos X.

We are seeking volunteers to finalize updating of screenshots throughout our user manual to reflect the current web app UI as a good percentage of screenshots were updated but throughout the user manual there are still a number of screenshots from our legacy community app UI. This would involve the following:

1. Log into the demo instance that we’re populating with clean sample data
2. For the section you’re assigned, follow the steps in the user manual to reproduce the screenshots in the new UI. All the flows should be the same, just the screens are different and navigation slightly different. 
3. You would then take the screenshot and insert into the documentation in gitbook the updated screenshot. 
Multiple people could work on this in parallel on the various sections that still need updating.

Please reach out if interested in helping and will share the next steps to get involved.
